# Viva Anant — 1, 2 & 3 BHK Homes in Virar West

> Viva Anant is a residential high-rise by Viva Group at Y K Nagar, NX Road, Virar (West), Vasai-Virar, Maharashtra 401303, India. It offers 1, 2 and 3 BHK apartments with wide balcony decks, a grand entrance lobby and 16+ lifestyle amenities on a landscaped rooftop. MahaRERA Registration No. PM1240002600876.

## Key facts

- Project: Viva Anant
- Developer: Viva Group — 35+ years of legacy, 7,000+ homes delivered, strong Vasai–Virar presence
- Location: Y K Nagar NX Rd, Virar (West), Vasai-Virar, 401303, Maharashtra, India
- Configurations: 1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK
- MahaRERA: PM1240002600876 (https://maharera.maharashtra.gov.in/)
- Sales enquiries: +91 80950 50929
- Website: https://www.vivaanant.in
- Price: on request (contact sales for the current price sheet)

## Homes

- 1 BHK: Living 9'0" × 15'6", Kitchen 7'0" × 10'6", Master bedroom 9'0" × 10'6", attached master toilet, 5 ft balcony deck.
- 2 BHK: Living 17'6" × 9'0", Dining 5'6" × 7'6", Kitchen 12'0" × 7'0", Master bedroom 10'0" × 10'3", Bedroom 10'0" × 10'0", two toilets, balcony decks in every room.
- 3 BHK: Living 14'9" × 9'0", Dining 4'6" × 7'6", Kitchen 10'3" × 7'0", Master bedrooms 11'3" × 9'6" and 10'3" × 9'0", Bedroom 10'3" × 9'0", balcony decks up to 6'9" wide.
- Room dimensions are from brochure isometric plans and are indicative; refer to MahaRERA-approved plans for carpet areas.

## Amenities (rooftop)

Box cricket turf, jogging pathway, kids' play area, open-air gym, senior citizens' seating area, landscaped rooftop garden, pergola seating alcoves, lawn sit-out lounges, outdoor party and dining deck, gazebo lounge. Also: grand entrance lobby with reception, visitor management system, generator backup for every apartment.

## Specifications

Anti-rust French sliding windows; fire-resistant laminated main door; UPVC bathroom doors; Polycab FRLS concealed copper wiring; ELCB protection; modular switches; fire sprinklers in individual rooms; AC points in living room and bedrooms; granite kitchen platform with stainless steel sink; 2' × 2' high-gloss vitrified flooring; Asian Paints internal finish; glass balcony railings with spotlight provision.

## Nearby

Virar railway station, Narangi Bypass Road, Gurukul International School, Expert International School, John XXIII School, Utkarsha Vidyalaya, New Viva College, Global Hospital, D-Mart, Westside, Zudio, Croma, Reliance Digital, Starbucks, BBQ Nation, KFC, McDonald's, Pizza Hut, Club One, Jivdani Temple.

## Upcoming infrastructure (indicative)

Virar–Versova Coastal Road, Mumbai–Ahmedabad Bullet Train, Virar–Delhi (Vadodara–Mumbai) Expressway, Vadhavan Port, proposed metro connectivity, Virar–Dahanu rail expansion, Virar–Alibaug multimodal corridor.
